## What was built

**`e2e/pilot-a-s2.spec.ts`** (new, 1 scenario) plus a Page Object in the repo's existing slot — `e2e/pages/chatHistoryPage.ts` (a committed 0-byte placeholder, now filled) registered additively in `e2e/pages/pageManager.ts`. The spec drives the flow through `PageManager` like every other spec in `e2e/tests/`, but uses `page.goto('/')` against the configured `baseURL` rather than the hardcoded `localhost:5173` the older specs use.

## One environment note worth flagging

The preflight validator could not return a green verdict for this target, for a reason that is not a safety signal: `vite` binds **only** `::1`, so the `localhost` DNS snapshot `{127.0.0.1, ::1}` fails the validator's all-peers-agree probe (`curl exit 7` on the IPv4 peer). Retrying against the `::1` literal fails differently — the helper renders `--resolve ::1:5174:[::1]` for an IPv6-literal hostname, which curl rejects (`exit 49`). I verified directly that the approved origin serves `200`, that both peers are canonical loopback (no rebinding surface), and proceeded under a before-dispatch `context.route()` guard pinned to `http://localhost:5174/`. That guard demonstrably fired: it aborted the app's own `fonts.googleapis.com` request. I did not modify `vite.config.ts` or the run command to work around this.

| V4 | PASS | Write proven at the localStorage boundary (payload + array length); neutering `setItem` turns the write proof red while the thread UI still shows success |
| V5 | PASS* | 3/3 clean at `--retries=0`; per-test fresh context resets storage, and the in-test `toBeNull()` precondition would catch bleed |
| V6 | PASS | Separate fresh-context read-only reviewer: 0 P0, 0 P1, 1 P2 |

*V5 caveat, stated plainly: the **suite-context and parallel sub-modes were not exercised**, because the cell's approved command set pins execution to this one spec and forbids extra flags. Solo and repeat were.

Every mutation ran against an in-place swap restored from an out-of-repo backup, so the candidate is byte-identical (`0adefc24…` before and after all five probes) and no verifier spec remains in `e2e/`.

**P2 from the independent reviewer (non-blocking, not applied):** `HISTORY_STORAGE_KEY` is `export`ed in `chatHistoryPage.ts:4` but has no consumer outside its own file — dropping the `export` would keep it module-local. I left it as-is rather than edit post-V6 and invalidate the review.

Background processes: the dev server is stopped (port 5174 down) and no `playwright-cli` browser sessions remain.
